theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tdc_dlc_ld_piece_mass_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (k : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → 1 ≤ k → x ∈ Q → x ≠ 0 → 0 < ε → C.support ∩ ball x ε = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x ε → (∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball x ε → HasMassDensity C y k) → ∃ ε' : ℝ, 0 < ε' ∧ C.support ∩ ball x ε' = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x ε' ∧ (∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball x ε' → HasMassDensity C y k) ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ ball x ε' → μHE[2] (W ∩ (Q : Set (Euclid P))) ≤ C.massOn W
